checks: Limitless import: exact printings, headers, repeated quantities, CRLF
Limitless import refuses mismatched names, unknown cards and totals
Limitless export round trips without changing printings
Setup draws hands, enforces Basics, places six prizes, automatically draws first turn
Modern attack restriction and opponent turn rejection
One Energy attachment per turn; opponent attachment and early evolution refused
Black & White permits first-turn attack and automatically ends it
ex profile skips the first draw; Diamond & Pearl disallows first-turn Trainers
Bill draws two and moves to discard through its implemented effect
Evolving on a subsequent turn preserves damage and attachments and clears conditions
Invalid and duplicate setup choices are rejected before mutation
Saved action journal restores exact setup, turn, deck order and pending choices
Weakness doubles attack damage before damage counters are placed
Knockouts discard the stack, award a prize, and require a legal replacement
No Pokémon remaining is an automatic loss
Deck-out is checked on mandatory turn draw
Historical Burn: XY heads causes no damage and remains; SM heads deals 20 then clears
Poison checkup applies automatically and Sleep prevents attacking
TCG Live symbolic Basic Energy, name-only Trainers, and padded collector numbers import
An engine-generated coin flip replays identically across saved matches
Path to the Peak suppresses Crobat V on-play draw while it is in the environment
WOTC starts with a mandatory first draw and permits Trainers and attacks
WOTC Confusion tails deals 20 self-damage and ends the turn
WOTC Confusion applies self-Weakness and PlusPower after Weakness

WOTC permits multiple paid normal retreats in a turn; modern permits one

Lightning Bolt combines a marked Active hit before applying PlusPower once
Mind Games and No Removal Gym charge each SER cost once on either cancellation branch

Ecogym treats Energy Burn converted DCE as colored and does not return knockout attachments

Protective Flame shields Bench damage but still permits damage to the Active

Psymimic blocks unpaid attacks and does not consume its Power when none are legal
Bolt only shuffles surviving Entei and includes every attachment without awarding a prize
Char places counters on Benched Pokemon during each checkup without Weakness reduction
Ecogym leaves the attackers own Super Energy Removal cost discarded

Hydroelectric Power counts Water units left after the complete mixed attack cost

Paint replaces the actual type and persists on Bench but clears on evolution
Texture Magic changes both optional stats and clears when each Pokemon is Benched
